text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. One major change is automation, where machines and software do repetitive tasks that people used to do. This saves time and reduces mistakes. There are also many productivity tools, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, that help employees work faster and more efficiently. Human-AI collaboration is becoming common, as people work together with AI systems to solve problems and make better decisions. However, these changes also affect jobs. Some tasks may disappear, while new roles appear that require different skills. For this reason, workers need to keep learning and adapting to stay successful in a modern workplace.
